'''Kas'tal''' is a [[draenei]] [[quest giver]] near the [[Dark Portal]] in the [[Blasted Lands]]. The apprentice of the [[riftwalker]] [[Akh Z'ador]], he was sent to survey suspicious fluctuations near the [[Dark Portal]] prior to his master's departure to search for the remainder of their tribe.<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|54|Novice In A Barren Land}}</ref>
